h: Why Rus Is Read on Atzeres: Poverty, Humility and the Kingship of Dovid

p: It says in the Magen Avraham
who cites the Yalkut on Rus:
"What does Rus have to do with Atzeres,
that it is read at the time of Matan Torah?
You prepare in Your goodness for the poor, O God'
before the Holy One, blessed be He:
Give my portion to the tribe of poverty,
for if the wealthy occupy themselves with me,
they will become haughty..." and so on.
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (נְדָרִים פא, א):
This is based on what Chazal say (Nedarim 81a):
"Be careful with the children of the poor,
for from them Torah will go forth..." and so on;
and the Ran explains, in his second explanation,
that they are humble in their own eyes.
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר (סוֹטָה כא, ב):
And this is based on what is said (Sotah 21b):
only in one who makes himself
'And wisdom — from nothingness it is found'" (Iyov 28:12).
"Why are words of Torah compared to water,
as it is written: 'Ho, everyone who thirsts,
Just as water leaves a high place...
only in one whose spirit is humble."
מוּסָב רַק עַל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
refers only to Torah she'b'al peh,
which is what is compared to water,
as is expounded there just before:
and regarding a worthy student it says:
לִקְרַאת צָמֵא הֵתָיוּ מָיִם (יְשַׁעְיָה כא, יד).
And it is to Torah she'b'al peh
If so, what is the reason
that Rus is read on Atzeres,
when the Torah she'bi'chsav was given?
It would have been more fitting to read it
when the last Tablets were given;
and it says in the Midrash Rabbah
that there should be in them halachos, Midrash and Aggados,
is also the Torah she'b'al peh.
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאִיתָא (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא צא, ב):
according to what it says (Bava Basra 91b):
וַיָּשֶׂם כִּסֵּא לְאֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ (מְלָכִים א ב, יט) —
"'And he placed a throne for the king's mother' (Melachim I 2:19) —
from her began the building of the kingship
הָיָה רַבָּן שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ,
was the master of all those endowed with Ruach HaKodesh,
That is: since he is a chariot
we call it Torah she'b'al peh,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הָרַמְבַּ״ן (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, א)
"Know this, for a great man states a matter
for then the kingship of the House of Dovid was built,
which was the root of Torah she'b'al peh.
And even though the root of Torah she'b'al peh
הוּא מִסִּטְרָא דְּעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע,
is from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק א כז, א),
מִכׇּל מָקוֹם מָצִינוּ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כה, א):
"Dovid, King of Yisrael, lives and endures";
and it also says (in Shemos Rabbah 8:1):
"At that moment Dovid came to life";
meaning, that he merited the Tree of Life,
for the time is then awakened
when the Commandments were bound with two crowns
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
That is: through the Torah she'b'al peh,
they can repair the "abundance of anger" (Koheles 1:18)
from the side of the Tree of Life.
And every year at the time of Matan Torah
what there was with the first Tablets:
the learning of Torah was implanted in their hearts,
and with the utterance "You shall have no other gods"
the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts,
and the words of Torah will be
from the side of the Tree of Life
And this is what is said in the holy Zohar
this is 'the river going forth from Eden,'
that is, Binah, the Supernal Mother,
as is written in the holy Zohar
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א כו, א, סוֹף הָעַמּוּד);
and it is the aspect of teshuvah,
and he will repent and be healed" (Yeshayah 6:10).
is to repair the "abundance of anger"
עַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה וְהַתְּשׁוּבָה.
through Torah she'b'al peh and teshuvah.
חֲגִיגָה ב, ג; בֵּיצָה ב, ד;
and the Holy One, blessed be He, completes
מִן הַסְּתָם נוֹלַד גַּם כֵּן בַּעֲצֶרֶת;
presumably he was also born on Atzeres;
and so it is written in the sefarim.
And of Dovid HaMelech, alav hashalom,
הַגֶּבֶר הוּקַם עָל (שְׁמוּאֵל ב כג, א) —
"'The man who was raised on high' (Shmuel II 23:1) —
who raised up the yoke of teshuvah,"
in order to repair the "abundance of anger."
And this is the reason that Megillas Rus —
she being the mother of royalty,
that is, the root of the building
of the kingship of the House of Dovid —
for that is the time to repair,
from the side of the Tree of Life,
That is, Dovid HaMelech, alav hashalom,
so that they merit eternal life,
and death will be merely like sleep and awakening;
and as death is called in the language of Chazal
"'And when you awaken, it shall converse with you' —

paragraphs.text: Magen Avraham, Orach Chaim 490:8, citing the Yalkut on Rus — "What does Rus have to do with Atzeres, that it is read at the time of the giving of the Torah? To teach you that the Torah was given only through suffering and poverty."

paragraphs.text: Nedarim 81a — "They sent from there: Be careful with the children of the poor, for from them Torah goes forth, as it says, 'Water shall flow from his buckets (midalyav)' (Bamidbar 24:7) — from the poor (dalim) among them Torah goes forth." Rashi: let them not be light in your eyes when teaching them Torah.

paragraphs.text: Sotah 21b (cited as 21a) — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Words of Torah endure only in one who makes himself as one who is not, as it is said, 'And wisdom — from nothing (me-ayin) shall it be found.'" Rashi: me-ayin — from one who makes himself as nothing.

paragraphs.text: Taanis 7a — "Rabbi Chanina bar Idi said: Why are the words of Torah likened to water, as it is written, 'Ho, all who are thirsty, go to the water' (Yeshayahu 55:1)? To tell you: just as water leaves a high place and goes to a low place, so the words of Torah endure only in one whose mind is humble."

paragraphs.text: Kiddushin 66a — "'And the Torah — what will become of it?' 'Behold, it is wrapped and set down in a corner; whoever wishes to learn, let him come and learn.'" Rashi: the sefer Torah lies wrapped with the mitzvos in it, and they will not be forgotten.

paragraphs.text: Bava Basra 91b — "'They dwelt there with the king in his work' (I Divrei HaYamim 4:23) — this is Rus the Moabite, who saw the kingship of Shlomo, the grandson of her grandson, as it says, 'And he placed a throne for the king's mother' (I Melachim 2:19); and Rabbi Elazar said: for the mother of kingship."

paragraphs.text: Bava Basra 12a — "From the day the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed, prophecy was taken from the prophets and given to the Sages… Abaye said: Know that this is so, for a great man says something, and the same is then reported in the name of another great man." The Ramban there infers that the Sages' teaching comes through a form of ruach hakodesh.

Rather, this is the secret: 'and He formed (vayitzer)' — one formation of good and one of evil: this is the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil… it has two formations, which are prohibited and permitted."

paragraphs.text: Rosh Hashanah 25a — "Rabbi Chiya saw the old moon still standing on the morning of the twenty-ninth. He threw a clod at it and said: Tonight we are to sanctify you, and you stand here?! Go, hide! Rebbi said to Rabbi Chiya: Go to Ein Tov, sanctify the month, and send me the sign: 'David, King of Israel, lives and endures.'"

paragraphs.text: Taanis 5b — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Yaakov Avinu did not die. He was asked: Was it for nothing that the eulogizers eulogized, the embalmers embalmed and the buriers buried? He answered: I am expounding a verse, as it says, 'And you, fear not, My servant Yaakov… for behold, I save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity' (Yirmeyahu 30:10) — it compares him to his seed: just as his seed is alive, so too he is alive." Rashi: he lives forever; they embalmed him because they thought he had died.

paragraphs.text: Shabbos 88a — "One hundred twenty myriads of destroying angels came down and removed [the crowns] from them, as it says, 'And the Children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Chorev' (Shemos 33:6)… Rabbi Yochanan said: Moshe merited all of them and took them, as the next verse says, 'And Moshe would take the tent.'" Rashi: the two crowns were of the radiance of the Shechinah.

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 253a (Pinchas) — "'And on the day of the first fruits, when you bring a new meal-offering' (Bamidbar 28:26). Rabbi Abba said: The day of the first fruits — which day is it? The river that goes out of Eden, which is the day of those supernal first fruits; on it the Torah depends, and it brings forth all the secrets of the Torah; and because it is the Tree of Life, the fruit of trees had to be brought."

paragraphs.text: Kiddushin 38a — "From where do we know that Moshe was born on the seventh of Adar? For it says, 'I am a hundred and twenty years old today' (Devarim 31:2): 'today' teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, sits and fills the years of the righteous from day to day and from month to month, as it says, 'The number of your days I will fill' (Shemos 23:26)."

paragraphs.text: Moed Katan 16b — "Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'The word of David son of Yishai, and the word of the man who was raised on high (hukam al)' (II Shmuel 23:1)? The word of David son of Yishai, who raised up the yoke (ullah) of teshuvah." Rashi: he repented first and opened the way for penitents.

paragraphs.text: Sotah 21a — "'And Torah is light' (Mishlei 6:23) — to tell you: just as light protects forever, so Torah protects forever. And it says, 'When you walk it shall lead you' — this is this world; 'when you lie down it shall guard you' — this is death; 'and when you awake it shall converse with you' — in the time to come." Rashi: it will plead your merit.
